why.j6-l4: 九折 is how Cantonese says ten percent off: the price is nine parts out of ten. The 9 and the 10 are the same offer, not a changed quantity.
why.j17-l8: both names the type and the size. The gloss lists those two items and does not add a separate numeral.
why.r16-l6: both and two refer to the same two plates. 兩碟 states that quantity once.
